questions.question: Add 24 586 and 18 937 in columns, explaining each carry.
questions.expected_answer: Units: 6 plus 7 is 13, write 3 carry 1. Tens: 8 plus 3 plus 1 is 12, write 2 carry 1. Hundreds: 5 plus 9 plus 1 is 15, write 5 carry 1. Thousands: 4 plus 8 plus 1 is 13, write 3 carry 1. Ten thousands: 2 plus 1 plus 1 is 4. The total is 43 523.

questions.question: Work out 24 586 minus 18 937 and check your answer by adding.
questions.expected_answer: 24 586 minus 18 937 is 5 649. Check: 18 937 plus 5 649 is 24 586, which is the number we started with, so the answer is correct.

questions.question: Explain how to work out 50 000 minus 23 476 using 49 999.
questions.expected_answer: 49 999 minus 23 476 needs no exchanging and gives 26 523. Because 49 999 is 1 less than 50 000, add 1 back to get 26 524.
